description: Run the AI-assisted development path from brainstorming-nex through planning, implementation, release QA, and pre-merge verification, with knowledge-base available as supporting context throughout.

dependencies.purpose: Run the pre-implementation requirement clarification and brainstorming design preparation stage.
dependencies.install_command: npx skills add git@git.zoom.us:ai-tools/skills.git --skill brainstorming-nex -g -y --agent claude-code cursor codex

dependencies.purpose: Turn the approved design into a detailed implementation plan and execution handoff.
Execute the approved implementation plan task by task with built-in review loops.
Require red-green-refactor discipline before behavior-changing production edits.
Require root-cause investigation before implementation fixes when verification fails.
Explore evidence-backed repair options and retry guidance when the shared repair stage needs solution synthesis before resuming the workflow.
dependencies.install_command: npx skills add git@git.zoom.us:ai-tools/skills.git --skill research-nex -g -y --agent claude-code cursor codex

dependencies.purpose: Provide source discovery and initial verification support for research-nex during repair-stage solution exploration.
dependencies.install_command: npx skills add git@git.zoom.us:ai-tools/skills.git --skill search-nex -g -y --agent claude-code cursor codex

dependencies.purpose: Run iOS build, test, run, debug, log, and UI automation verification through XcodeBuildMCP with controlled DerivedData path handling.
dependencies.install_command: npx skills add git@git.zoom.us:ai-tools/skills.git --skill xcodebuildmcp-cli -g -y --agent claude-code cursor codex

dependencies.purpose: Edit Xcode project, pbxproj, target membership, build settings, and asset catalog surfaces through XcodeProjectCLI.

dependencies.purpose: Run change-aware release QA after implementation verification and before pre-merge code review.

dependencies.purpose: Compare approved design, reference screenshot, or baseline image artifacts against runtime screenshots during release QA.

dependencies.install_command: npx skills add callstack/agent-device --skill agent-device -g -y --agent claude-code cursor codex

dependencies.purpose: Preflight the optional agent-device executable; required mode performs additional version, device, runner, and artifact checks.
Run a pre-merge code review on the current local diff or branch state before final delivery.
Collect fresh verification evidence and block completion claims until the workflow can prove it is done.
Apply Zoom iOS client review standards for memory, threading, concurrency, architecture, security, and UI-layer correctness during pre-merge review.
